study type: Prospective cohort study and nested case-control study
cohort: The study involved 1005 pregnant women recruited at their first antenatal visit in Guangzhou, China, and followed until delivery.
finding: Partner smoking/drinking is associated with an increased risk of gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) and adverse pregnancy outcomes, with a stronger effect observed when combined with GDM than either factor alone.
mod_finding: Partner smoking/drinking alone was associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery (RR 1.5, 1.0-2.1).
